title.zh: 用《Artificial heart valve》给已印的concrete pump split piston φ195画一张目录

description.en: concrete pump split piston φ195 is restated under Artificial heart valve. A φ195 split piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai split-piston page. It is sold as a set. The materials printed for this row are polyurethane only. No published pump page assigns φ195 to a model.
description.zh: concrete pump split piston φ195放在《Artificial heart valve》的结构下重述。φ195 分体活塞是邢台分体活塞页上的一条外径。按套供货。这一行印出的材料是只有聚氨酯。没有任何已公布泵页把 φ195 指定到某一型号。

h1.en: The printed concrete pump split piston φ195 line, ordered as Artificial heart valve orders its page
h1.zh: 已印的concrete pump split piston φ195，按《Artificial heart valve》的页面次序来写

directAnswer.en: Artificial heart valve is an encyclopedia page. concrete pump split piston φ195 remains a Xingtai catalogue line. The two meet only in the order of the sections. A φ195 split piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai split-piston page. It is sold as a set. The materials printed for this row are polyurethane only. No published pump page assigns φ195 to a model.
directAnswer.zh: 《Artificial heart valve》是百科页。concrete pump split piston φ195仍是邢台目录中的一行。两者只在章节次序上相遇。 φ195 分体活塞是邢台分体活塞页上的一条外径。按套供货。这一行印出的材料是只有聚氨酯。没有任何已公布泵页把 φ195 指定到某一型号。

body.en: The heading “Background” is structural. What it is allowed to carry is the wording already on the row for this note. The split piston is a replacement set for S-valve concrete pumps, supplied from Xingtai by Hebei Pinjin Machinery. The full outer-diameter list is φ150, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ220, φ230, φ250, φ260 and φ280. This note is only the φ195 row, materials: polyurethane only. Unit: set. The page does not print a compound grade, a hardness, or a service life. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The integral-piston page is a different part. Where the same φ195 also appears there, it is still not a pump-model assignment. Electric 20's 80 mm figure is a pipe inner diameter, not a piston outer diameter. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 标题“背景”只起骨架作用。它能够携带的，是这篇笔记对应那一行已经印出的文字。 分体活塞是河北品锦机械从邢台供应的 S 阀混凝土泵替换套件。全部外径是 φ150, φ180, φ195, φ200, φ220, φ230, φ250, φ260 and φ280。本文只写 φ195 这一行，材料：只有聚氨酯。单位：套。页面没有印胶料牌号、硬度或寿命。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 整体活塞是另一件配件。若同一个 φ195 也出现在那边，仍然不是泵型号的指定。电动20的 80 mm 是输送管内径，不是活塞外径。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: Nothing about the phrase “Bioprosthetic tissue valves” is a second data sheet. The data-sheet fragment, if one was printed, is quoted next. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write split piston, φ195, the material row (polyurethane only), and the quantity in sets. Leave life and pump model blank if the machine check is not done. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: “来源章节：Bioprosthetic tissue valves”这几个字不是第二张数据表。若目录印过数据，下面引用的才是那一句。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明分体活塞、φ195、材料行（只有聚氨酯）和套数。若还没在机器上核对，寿命和泵型号留空。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: The contents list of the source page includes “Tissue-engineered valves”. This section borrows that name and then repeats a printed fragment. A φ195 split piston is one outer-diameter row on the Xingtai split-piston page. It is sold as a set. The materials printed for this row are polyurethane only. No published pump page assigns φ195 to a model. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 来源页目录里有“来源章节：Tissue-engineered valves”。本节借用这个名字，然后复述已经印出的片段。 φ195 分体活塞是邢台分体活塞页上的一条外径。按套供货。这一行印出的材料是只有聚氨酯。没有任何已公布泵页把 φ195 指定到某一型号。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

heading.en: Differences between mechanical and tissue valves
heading.zh: 来源章节：Differences between mechanical and tissue valves

body.en: Where the source outline says “Differences between mechanical and tissue valves”, the catalogue fragment below is the fragment a buyer is allowed to copy. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: 来源大纲写到“来源章节：Differences between mechanical and tissue valves”时，下面这句才是买方可以照抄的目录原文。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

heading.en: Functional requirements of artificial heart valves
heading.zh: 来源章节：Functional requirements of artificial heart valves

body.en: Use “Functional requirements of artificial heart valves” to see where this block sits in the source article. The purchasing sentence is the printed fragment, not the encyclopedia prose. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: 用“来源章节：Functional requirements of artificial heart valves”看这一节在来源文章中的位置。采购时要抄的是已印片段，不是百科正文。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

heading.zh: 来源章节：Artificial heart valve repair

body.en: “Artificial heart valve repair” is a heading on the crawled page, used here only as the section name. It does not create a measurement. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: “来源章节：Artificial heart valve repair”是抓到的那一页自己的章节名，这里只拿来当标题，不另造一个测量值。 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: The contents list of the source page includes “Additional images”. This section borrows that name and then repeats a printed fragment. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 分体活塞 page plus this size and the quantity. The heading stops there. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_heart_valve
body.zh: 来源页目录里有“来源章节：Additional images”。本节借用这个名字，然后复述已经印出的片段。 用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明分体活塞这一页、这一尺寸和数量。 标题到此为止。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artificial_heart_valve

question.en: Why is Artificial heart valve not a source of extra ratings for concrete pump split piston φ195?
question.zh: 为什么《Artificial heart valve》不能给concrete pump split piston φ195增加额定值？

answer.en: This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
